title: Return coherent explicitly selected engineering records and subject identities
statement: The system shall provide read-only project capability inspection and explicit actor-selected current record queries with coherent identity, bounded complete meaning and observable absence or failure, without deriving workflow authority or choosing a recovery action.

what.problem: Broad or inferred reads can conceal missing selected information, combine different states, or be mistaken for authoritative progression advice.
what.desired_outcome: Callers obtain the requested recorded content or subject identity with enough state and scope information to decide their next action explicitly.

why.rationale: Useful scoped information reduces accidental dependence on unrelated records, stale pages, or an inferred next stage.

stakeholders: Engineers and reviewers operating on recorded engineering work
Engineering agents acting on explicit actor decisions
Maintainers and consumers of the published command-line interface

conditions: A caller inspects executable capabilities, resumes an explicitly selected Change, reads a selected Review or Verification, or supplies compared reads for a task.

contexts: Public CLI operations over the associated project store and explicitly selected contained engineering subjects.

how.approach: Provide explicit scoped current-context and item queries plus project capability inspection through the current CLI, preserving coherent values and truthful limitations.

how_much.scope: Current operational query responsibility; no requirement to scan docs/changes, expose SQL, enumerate the database or preserve the predecessor query grammar.

acceptance_criteria: Change context and item reads preserve explicit selected scope, complete current values, contract, revision, limitations and omissions; retrieval is not engineering adequacy.
Selected Review, Verification, Evidence and Decision accounts expose the meaning and support needed for current decisions without requiring the entire database.
Missing store, absent selected item, invalid/corrupt state and missing retained payload remain distinguishable. None becomes inferred approval or an empty substitute database.
A bounded selection returns complete admissible accounts or an explicit size failure; it never silently truncates rationale or unresolved issues.
Compared subject observations identify the explicitly compared scope; reported and unknown basis remain distinct. No standalone subject-hashing command is required.
Project capabilities reports executable contract/task availability and observed backend standing without selecting a Change or workflow authority.
Reads never initialize, import or restore a store implicitly; only storage-internal atomic recovery may establish an already determined ordinary outcome.
constraints: Current selected task/query contract; predecessor filesystem discovery and field-projection interfaces are retired in the successor.
